findings.comment: Adjacent land uses not labeled on site plan. The SF-3 property to the south (which triggers compatibility standards per facts.md) is not identified with any land use designation. While zoning is labeled for north (MF-4-CO) and east (MF-2-CO) adjacent properties, the south property has no land use label.

Vacant adjoining property not identified as vacant on site plan. The south adjacent property shows no building footprints or structures on the drawing and appears to be vacant, but is not labeled with the required notation 'VACANT'.

Adjacent property zoning designation not shown on site plan. The south adjacent property (identified in facts.md as SF-3 parcel 0406100210 triggering Subchapter F compatibility standards) has no zoning label. While MF-4-CO is labeled to the north and MF-2-CO to the east, the critical SF-3 designation is absent from the south property.

applicableAreas: Site boundaries abut multiple zoning districts
findings.comment: Zoning district boundary not shown or labeled for all adjacent zones. The site abuts MF-2, MF-4-CO, MF-2-CO, and SF-3 zoning districts. While north (MF-4-CO) and east (MF-2-CO) are labeled, the SF-3 zone boundary to the south is not shown or labeled.

applicableAreas: North adjacent property; possibly other sides
findings.comment: Existing building footprints on adjoining properties within 50 feet not shown on site plan. The east adjacent property shows 'Existing Apartment Building' labeled and depicted. However, the north adjacent property (MF-4-CO zoning) shows no building footprints within the 50-foot vicinity, though buildings likely exist on this multi-family parcel; footprints must be shown if they are within 50 feet of the site boundary.

Required note absent when no buildings exist on adjoining lots within 50 feet. The south adjacent property shows no structures on the site plan and appears to be vacant. If no buildings exist on adjoining lots within 50 feet, the site plan must include a note stating 'no buildings exist on adjoining lots within 50 feet'. This note is not present.

applicableAreas: All sides of site (surrounded by residential zoning: MF-2, MF-3, MF-4, SF-3)
findings.comment: Exterior lighting above the second floor restriction not explicitly stated on site plan. The plan includes a note requiring full cut-off and shielding per Subchapter E 2.5, but does not explicitly state the General Site Plan Notes requirement that exterior lighting above the second floor is prohibited when adjacent to residential property. This restriction must be explicitly documented.

Zoning designations on mylars cannot be verified. Mylar documents are not available in the submitted project files; review of mylar compliance with zoning designation requirements cannot be completed without access to these documents.

Verification of building dimension callouts on site plan cannot be completed. Tabular building data (gross floor area, coverage, heights) is provided in tables on Sheet 9, but specific dimension callouts (length × width) on the actual drawing itself cannot be verified from the available documentation. Dimension callouts must be shown on the drawing, not only in tables.

Continuous perimeter boundary lines including roofline and attached canopies cannot be verified. The site plan drawing shows building layouts and outlines, but the specific requirement for a complete continuous perimeter boundary line that includes roofline and any attached canopies cannot be confirmed from the available documentation; detailed examination of the drawing would be required.

Mechanical equipment noise specifications not found in submitted documentation. No mechanical equipment schedule or manufacturer specifications demonstrating noise levels at or below 70 dB(A) at the property line adjacent to residential uses are available in the reviewed site plan sheets. An equipment schedule with noise ratings at property line distances must be provided.
